args.title: Bellwether Office — Retail returns logistics (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have reached 24%, making returns a major cost and logistics burden for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth, offering a clear operational efficiency lever.
- Resale within 10 days of return kept most of the margin, highlighting speed-to-resale as a key margin-preservation strategy.
